scenes.text: Did you know there is a mysterious fifty-mile strip of deep wilderness in America where you could theoretically commit the ultimate crime and walk away completely free?
It is called the Zone of Death, and because of a bizarre constitutional loophole, the law requires your jury to be selected exclusively from the exact district where the crime occurred.
But here is the terrifying catch: this remote section of Idaho has a population of absolutely zero, meaning a legal jury can never be formed and a trial is literally impossible.
Even though Congress has known about this dangerous glitch for years they still haven't fixed it, so would you ever dare to visit, and will you follow for more secrets?
